title: Split a stack — or rejoin split pages
description: The Review tools for fixing page grouping by hand: the Split tool (by page range, one file per page, or every N pages) when one scan holds several documents, and the reverse — the 'Join with page N' button that stitches a wrongly-cut document back together. The Split flyout and its options record live on any open document; committing a real split needs a multi-page stack, and the Join button only appears on a document ScanFinder pair-held — see the report for what needs a real multi-page / pair-held doc.

steps.narration: Sometimes one scan holds several documents, or the reverse: a single document ends up split across pages. Review lets you fix both by hand.
steps.caption: Fix how pages are grouped

steps.narration: Open Review from the side bar.
steps.caption: Open Review

steps.narration: Everything's grouped by sender — open one,
steps.caption: 1. A sender's documents

steps.narration: and open one of its documents.
steps.caption: 2. Open a document

steps.narration: The scissors button opens the Split tool for this document.
steps.caption: 3. Open the Split tool

steps.narration: There are three ways to split: by page range, one file for every page, or every N pages.
steps.caption: By range, per page, or every N

steps.narration: For ranges you'd type something like 1-2, 3 — pages one and two become one document, page three another.
steps.caption: e.g. 1-2, 3

steps.narration: Click Split and each part becomes its own document in Review. The original scan is replaced, so do this on a real multi-page stack.
steps.caption: 4. Split into separate documents

steps.narration: The reverse is just as easy. If a document was cut in the wrong place, its held-back page offers a Join with page N button. One click puts it back together.
steps.caption: Rejoin: Join with page N

steps.narration: Split when a scan holds several documents; rejoin when one got separated.
steps.caption: Split or rejoin — both by hand
